jurisdiction: City and County of Honolulu, HI (island of Oahu)
code_name: Revised Ordinances of Honolulu (ROH) Chapter 21, Land Use Ordinance (LUO): Article 3 zoning districts, Article 5 use regulations / Table 21-5.1 (Table of Permitted Uses)
edition: Article 3 text from the Zoneomics mirror (zoneomics.com/code/honolulu-HI/chapter_4), which already shows the Ord. 25-2 amendments. Table 21-5.1 and Article 5 use standards read from the enacted text of Honolulu Ordinance 25-2 (Bill 64 (2023), CD2, FD2, signed Jan 2025) as a scanned PDF on American Legal; table cells were read from page images. Mirror: tag 'check source'.
caveats: American Legal codelibrary pages returned 403 to automated fetching; Article 3 text came from the Zoneomics mirror, so verify against codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/honolulu before relying on it.

Table 21-5.1 (use table) was read from the PDF of Ordinance 25-2 (enacted bill text). Any amendments after January 2025 were not checked. The older Table 21-3 Master Use Table (2019/2021 supplement) is superseded; it still listed 'Data processing facilities'.

Table 21-5.1 has columns P-2, AG-1, AG-2, Country, R-20/R-10, R-7.5/R-5/R-3.5, A-1..A-3, AMX-1..3, Resort, B-1, B-2, BMX-3, BMX-4, I-1, I-2, I-3, IMX-1. It has NO column for P-1 or F-1 (P-1 is governed by State agencies, F-1 allows all military and federal uses), none for Pub, WI or Kak.

Key to the table: P = permitted; C = major conditional use permit (public hearing); Cm = minor conditional use permit; PRU = plan review use; Ac = accessory use; * = use-specific standards apply (Article 5); + = on State Land Use Agricultural District land a special use permit approved by the Planning Commission (HRS 205) may be required; '--' = not allowed. Where two symbols appear all apply.

Land in the State Land Use Conservation District is regulated by the State DLNR under HRS 183C regardless of the City zoning (LUO 21-5.20(e)). Land in the State Agricultural District is also subject to HRS 205 / HAR 15-15 use limits, which can be stricter than the City table.

Data centers: the LUO has no 'data center' use. The former 'Data processing facilities' use (mainframe digital records) was struck by Ord. 25-2 and is not in Table 21-5.1. Under LUO 21-5.20(b)-(c) an unlisted use is allowed only as an accessory use or after the DPP director decides whether it fits a listed use (for example General office or General storage/warehousing) or needs a zoning variance. Treat as 'not addressed; director determination'.

Solar: no stand-alone solar row in Table 21-5.1; solar generation is a Utility use sized by 21-5.60-6(a)(2): ground-mounted under 20 acres is a small utility, 20 acres or more (or any site in the State agricultural or conservation district, or aggregated adjacent facilities over 20 acres) is a medium utility; generation over 5 MW is a large utility per the definition. The interplay of the 20-acre rule and the 5 MW 'Utility, Large' definition was not reconciled; confirm with DPP.

Lot sizes, height, yards and FAR for Article 3 districts come from the Zoneomics mirror's Tables 21-3.1 to 21-3.5; several table cells were misaligned in extraction (noted per district). 'Height per zoning map' districts have a map height (not in the text).

Pub (Public Precinct), Resort when inside Waikiki, WI (Waterfront Industrial Precinct) and Kak were not read in detail. Waikiki Special District uses are in Table 21-9.6(A) and Article 9 (Special District Regulations); Kakaako Special Design District is Appendix 21-F; the State's Kakaako Community Development District is run by the Hawaii Community Development Authority under HAR Ch. 15-22 (Mauka) and 15-23 (Makai) per general knowledge, not read here.

Parcel counts and acreage are not in the code; zoning-map height limits, overlays (flood, shoreline, special management area, TOD, planned development, cluster permits) and State Land Use district were not checked.
